name: idolYAKI: From Delinquents to Pop Stars
source:
Become friends or foes with the three most notorious criminals at your school as you help them transform into pop idols and compete in a nearby contest! A short, quick game with six possible endings!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1686810/]Steam[/url]]
